name: Clay Bearnson

bio.statement: In his pamphlet statement, Bearnson lists his occupation as small business owner with a service-industry background, and prior service on the Medford City Council and Medford Urban Renewal Agency from 2015 to 2022.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Small Business Owner Occupational Background: Service Industry

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Jackson/Josephine edition (Book 3), p. 37

bio.statement: Bearnson lists prior governmental experience including Medford City Council and the Medford Urban Renewal Agency (2015-2022) and Council Vice President in 2019.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: Medford City Council/Medford Urban Renewal Agency (MURA) (2015-2022); Council VP (2019)

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Jackson/Josephine edition (Book 3), p. 37

positions.statement: Bearnson says universal healthcare is necessary and financially viable and that he will work to make it a reality in Oregon.
positions.excerpt: Universal healthcare is necessary and financially viable. I will work to make this a reality in Oregon.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Jackson/Josephine edition (Book 3), p. 37

positions.statement: Bearnson says he would lower taxes for working families, individuals and small businesses while raising taxes on capital and wealth.
positions.excerpt: Lower taxes for working families, individuals, and small businesses while raising taxes on capital and wealth for the betterment of all.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Jackson/Josephine edition (Book 3), p. 37

positions.statement: Bearnson lists protecting constitutional rights, including a statewide ban on Flock surveillance, the construction of data centers and the sale of personal data, among his policy initiatives.
positions.excerpt: Protect all of our constitutional rights, including a statewide ban on Flock surveillance, the construction of data centers, and the sale of our data to big tech oligarchs

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Jackson/Josephine edition (Book 3), p. 37

positions.statement: Bearnson proposes amending the Oregon constitution to redefine the powers Oregon grants to corporations operating in the state.
positions.excerpt: Amending our constitution to redefine the powers that Oregon grants to corporations operating in our state

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Jackson/Josephine edition (Book 3), p. 37

positions.statement: Bearnson says young people deserve affordable education and housing, with pathways to homeownership and entrepreneurship.
positions.excerpt: Our youth deserve a habitable planet, affordable education and housing, with pathways to homeownership and entrepreneurship.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Jackson/Josephine edition (Book 3), p. 37
